content:
Today's special edition of "9to5Toys Lunch Break" brings you updates — both the AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 are down by US$120, making it one of the best prices ever, while Best Buy, in celebration of its 60th anniversary, has launched a one-day Apple-exclusive promotion.

As the AirTag 2 returns to its all-time low price, brand-new M5 Pro MacBook Pro models are also US$400 off today, plus the iPhone Air is down by US$170 (or up to US$406 off on open-box models), along with plenty of great deals on official Apple accessories.
